jobs.description: Agora Opens Up: API & MCP Access to Your Data Agora Opens Up: Connect your data to the AI and systems your firm runs on. Explore the launch → Build on your Agora data. Connect it to Ask a question, connect a system, or bring your whole stack in: Agora meets your team where it already works. Talk to an expert WHATEVER YOUR NEED, WE HAVE THE RIGHT FIT Agora opens up, on every surface. Five ways in and out of Agora, each built for a different job. Jump straight to the one you need. “I need an answer to my investor's question, right now.” MCP “I need my software to pull data from Agora automatically.” API “I need my other systems to keep feeding Agora with data.” Agora Connect “I need Agora data and reports in my inbox.” Scheduled reports & triggered alerts “I need help doing the work, not just fetching data.” Cortex MCP Agora Pro Real-time Agora-based answers, in your AI tools. Ask Agora, right where you work Connect the AI tools your team already uses to live Agora data, and get answers grounded in your real numbers, not a stale export. Compliant Agora permissions apply Take a closer look at MCP + API how it works? Three simple steps STEP 1 Connect securely Enable the connection in your chosen AI tool using clear, step-by-step instructions. STEP 2 Ask your question Ask your AI tool anything about your Agora data, right in the chat you already work in. STEP 3 Get an instant answer Your AI tool answers immediately, straight from Agora, read-only and fully permissioned. 1 / 2 API Agora Pro Your data leaves Agora on its own schedule No prompt, no chat window: each of these runs system to system, on a schedule, job-by-job, with a defined field-level mapping. Keep your CRM current • Leads, contacts, profiles and orgs sync out on schedule • Filtered by type, status, or tag - pull only what changed • Your CRM's own ID rides along on every record Transactional data to accounting • Distributions, capital calls, and fees flow straight into your GL • Lands straight in your accounting system, no manual re-entry • Matches your accounting system's existing structure Centralized business intelligence • Fund and portfolio data joins across your systems • One consolidated view, no manual reconciliation • Replaces manual exports across every tool you run agora connect Paid service Bring your data in. Your investor data doesn’t start in Agora – it might live in a CRM, your fund administrator, or a system like Yardi or AppFolio. Agora Connect brings it in and keeps it current – no export-reformat-upload cycle every time something changes, no technical resources needed on your end. Agora Connect already made sure the data's there. MCP answers questions about data that's already in Agora. Connect is how data from your other tools gets into Agora. Agora Connect handles the complexity for you. API moves data in real time, but needs dev resources most firms don't have. Connect matches your data to Agora's model, then checks it against your records. From live Agora data to wherever your team already looks. Scheduled reports Delivered on the cadence your team runs on, ready before the meeting starts. Alerts Trigger-based, fires the moment something needs attention – a capital call sitting overdue, a raise that’s stalled. BUILT TO CONNECT EVERYTHING Work across your stack, stay open beyond it - your AI work surface. Cortex connects to the systems your team already runs on, so everything moves forward in one place, in context. Act across your tools to get things done: draft, analyze, and run processes that touch Agora and the rest of your stack, all without leaving your screen. MCP and API give you access to Agora data. Cortex is where it all comes together. Read more WHAT CAN BE ACHIEVED One system, working across everything Bring all your tools together Connect Agora to the apps your team already uses in seconds, so every team's work lands in one place and stays aligned. Automate every workflow Sync between Agora and the platforms you run - routine updates fire on their own, manual work disappears. Drive results with full visibility A real-time, cross-platform view that keeps data aligned and your team empowered, turning insights into decisions. A closer look at MCP + API Built for trust Your Agora permissions stay intact, every time. Every connection runs through Agora’s existing governance layer, with the same rules and no new blind spots. 01 Every fund walled off No cross-fund visibility beyond what your firm's own permissions already allow. 02 Permissions mirrored to your firm Nobody sees anything through a connection they couldn't already see by logging in. 03 Every action logged and reviewable Activity is tracked and available for your firm to audit, on every surface. Visit the Agora Trust Center Frequently asked questions Have more questions? Write to us at info@agorareal.com What's the difference between Agora Connect, API, and MCP? MCP lets a person ask Agora a question directly, from the AI tool they already use, no setup beyond connecting your account. API keeps your own systems current with what’s in Agora automatically, but it’s built for developers: you’ll need a dev team to build and maintain the integration. Agora Connect gets you the same kind of automatic sync without any of that. Agora’s own team handles the field mapping and validation for you. Does this replace my reporting or BI tools? For most firms, no. Agora’s own reporting and business intelligence solutions already liveswhere your data is. When you do need data to leave Agora on a schedule, that’s exactly what the export and alert tools above are for. How does this help us avoid data silos? Every surface on this page keeps your systems talking to each other automatically. Agora Connect pulls data in, API pushes it back out, and MCP puts it in front of whoever’s asking. Nothing sits stuck in one system waiting for someone to move it by hand. How does this reduce manual work for my team? Scheduled reports, triggered alerts, and automatic data

Explore the launch → Blog Agora partners with Entrata to expand investment management capabilities for multifamily owners Company news Press releases Agora partners with Entrata to expand investment management capabilities for multifamily owners Written by Taylor Mayer on Apr 09, 2026 Contents Discover what Agora can do for you Talk to an expert New integration delivers real-time financial visibility, automated reporting, and centralized ownership data within the Entrata platform Bringing investment management directly into Entrata Entrata , a leading AI-powered operating system for the multifamily industry, today announced a new partnership with Agora , a purpose-built investment management platform for real estate owners and operators. The integration brings investment management functionality directly into the Entrata platform, allowing customers to work with their investment and ownership data alongside their core property operations. Automating reporting and reducing manual workflows Through the partnership, ownership and investment data from Agora can be securely integrated into Entrata’s unified data layer for each customer at the customer’s discretion, allowing operators to track owners and portfolio-level financials in real time. This centralized approach enables teams to connect financial systems across their portfolios while reducing manual reporting workflows and administrative overhead. All data sharing and usage is managed in accordance with client permissions and applicable privacy and compliance standards. “As owners demand greater transparency and faster access to financial information, operators need modern tools that connect investment management directly to day-to-day operations,” said Stephanie Fuhrman, Industry Strategist and SVP of Corporate Development at Entrata. “By partnering with Agora, we’re extending Entrata’s platform to support real estate investment management at scale, giving our customers a powerful, integrated way to serve owners while simplifying complex reporting requirements.” Closing the gap between operations and investment management Agora’s platform is designed for real estate investment management, and supports many asset classes and management needs, including multifamily owners and operators. The integration automates the delivery of financial reports required by owners and investors, ensuring consistent and accurate reporting across portfolios. With real-time access to their financial data, owners gain clearer insights into performance while operators reduce reliance on spreadsheets and disconnected systems. “Multifamily real estate has evolved into a sophisticated asset class, yet much of the industry still manages investment reporting manually,” said Bar Mor, CEO and co-founder of Agora. “Operators shouldn’t have to choose between operational efficiency and investor transparency. By integrating Agora’s investment management data within Entrata’s platform, we’re closing that gap and setting the standard for how real estate firms connect operations in a unified workflow.” Building the future of real estate investment management As ownership structures grow more complex and investor expectations increase, operators are rethinking how operational and investment data should work together across their portfolios. This integration is available today, extending Entrata’s platform to support investment management alongside core property operations. By unifying ownership data, financial systems, and reporting within a single operating system, Entrata and Agora are helping multifamily teams reduce complexity, improve accuracy, and deliver a more transparent experience for owners and investors.
